1.explanation:
• DataTable/README.md and DataTable/stories/ provide the exact usage pattern and example code for inline action menus within a DataTable row, so you can see how OverflowMenu is being mounted into each row.
• DataTable/tools/ contains any helper plugins or class name overrides that DataTable applies around its inline actions setup, which could be affecting focus styles on child menus.
• OverflowMenu/README.md defines the baseline keyboard behavior and CSS classes that should apply to menu items under focus when the component is used outside of a table context.
• OverflowMenu/migrate-to-7.x.md and OverflowMenuItem/migrate-to-7.x.md document changes in class names or style scaffolding across versions that may have inadvertently removed or renamed the CSS rules that highlight focused menu items when nested inside another component.
1.bug_scenario: In the DataTable row “inline actions” example, when you open an OverflowMenu via keyboard (Tab → Enter/Space), the menu opens but as you press ↑/↓ to move through the options, no menu‐item ever shows a highlight or focus ring. The trigger button itself shows a blue focus border when opened, but none of the OverflowMenuItem entries inside the table get the expected background or outline to indicate which item is “active” under keyboard navigation.
